title: AMPure Purification Protocol
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sk7eczn

steps.title: Equilibrate AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Remove the AMPure beads from the refrigerator, allow them to reach room temperature, and mix thoroughly without vortexing.

steps.title: Add beads to DNA and mix
steps.instruction: Add the desired ratio of AMPure beads to the DNA sample and mix well by pipetting.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes to allow DNA to bind to the beads.

steps.title: Capture beads on magnet
steps.instruction: Place the tube or plate on a magnetic rack and let it stand for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: After the 5‑minute stand, aspirate and discard the supernatant while the beads remain on the magnet.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol (first wash)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, then aspirate and discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol (second wash)
steps.instruction: Repeat: add 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, aspirate and discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Keep the tube on the magnetic rack and wait until the bead pellet is completely dry; do not remove the tube from the rack to avoid bead loss.

steps.title: Elution buffer addition
steps.instruction: Add the desired volume of 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0) or nuclease‑free water to wet the dried beads, adding an extra 1 µL to the final volume to prevent loss of beads.

steps.title: Release beads from magnet
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack.

steps.title: Resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads by pipetting up and down or vortexing.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate for 10 minutes; incubation at 37 °C can improve DNA yield.

steps.title: Re‑capture beads
steps.instruction: Place the tube back on the magnetic rack and let it stand for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Pipette out and save the supernatant containing the eluted DNA; do not discard this supernatant.
